atlas.druty.oczko.k.podpis: The right needle goes into the stitch from front to back, with the yarn at the back.
atlas.druty.oczko.k.opis_alt: Drawing of a knit stitch: the right needle enters the first stitch on the left needle from the front, the yarn wraps around it and is pulled through, and the old stitch slides off.
atlas.druty.oczko.k.krok1: Insert the right needle into the first stitch on the left needle, from front to back.
atlas.druty.oczko.k.krok2: Wrap the yarn under and over the right needle.
atlas.druty.oczko.k.krok3: Pull the yarn through the stitch with the right needle.
atlas.druty.oczko.k.krok4: Slip the old stitch off the left needle; the new stitch stays on the right needle.
atlas.druty.oczko.p.podpis: The yarn is in front, and the right needle goes into the stitch from back to front.
atlas.druty.oczko.p.opis_alt: Drawing of a purl stitch: with the yarn in front, the right needle enters the stitch from the back, a new loop is pulled through, and the old stitch slides off.
atlas.druty.oczko.p.krok1: With the yarn in front, insert the right needle into the first stitch on the left needle, from back to front.
atlas.druty.oczko.p.krok2: Pull a loop through the stitch with the right needle.
atlas.druty.oczko.p.krok3: Slip the old stitch off the left needle; the new stitch stays on the right needle.
atlas.druty.oczko.p.uwaga_nitka: When you switch between knit and purl, bring the yarn between the needles, not over them.
atlas.druty.scieg.stst.podpis:
Worked flat, stockinette alternates a knit row and a purl row.
Worked in the round, you knit every round.
atlas.druty.scieg.stst.uwaga_strony: The knit side is usually the right side; when the purl side is used as the right side, it is called reverse stockinette.
atlas.druty.scieg.stst.opis_alt: Drawing of stockinette fabric seen from the right side.
atlas.druty.scieg.garter.podpis:
Worked flat, garter stitch means you knit every row.
In the round, you knit one round and purl the next.
atlas.druty.scieg.garter.uwaga_strony:
Garter stitch looks almost the same on both sides.
Purling every row also gives garter stitch.
atlas.druty.scieg.garter.opis_alt: Drawing of garter stitch fabric, which looks almost the same on both sides.
atlas.druty.scieg.garter.krok1: Garter fabric, the same on both sides.
atlas.druty.scieg.rib.podpis: In ribbing, knit stitches line up over knit stitches and purl stitches over purl stitches.
atlas.druty.scieg.rib.rib1x1: Knit one, purl one ribbing: cast on an even number of stitches and work knit one, purl one across every row.
atlas.druty.scieg.rib.rib2x2:
Knit two, purl two ribbing: cast on a multiple of 4 plus 2 stitches.
Row 1 starts and ends with 2 knit stitches, and row 2 with 2 purl stitches.
atlas.druty.scieg.rib.opis_alt: Drawing of 1×1 ribbing: single columns of knit stitches alternate with single columns of purl stitches.
atlas.druty.scieg.rib.krok1: Knit columns sit over knit columns, purl columns over purl columns.
atlas.druty.ujecie.k2tog.podpis: A single decrease that leans to the right.
atlas.druty.ujecie.k2tog.opis_alt: Drawing of knit 2 together: two stitches are knit as one, and the new stitch leans to the right.
atlas.druty.ujecie.k2tog.krok1: The two stitches to be worked together.
atlas.druty.ujecie.k2tog.krok2: Insert the right needle into the next 2 stitches at once and knit them as one knit stitch.
atlas.druty.ujecie.k2tog.krok3: One stitch remains, leaning to the right.
atlas.druty.ujecie.ssk.podpis: A single decrease that leans to the left.
atlas.druty.ujecie.ssk.opis_alt: Drawing of slip, slip, knit: two stitches are slipped one at a time and then knit together, leaning to the left.
atlas.druty.ujecie.ssk.krok1: Slip two stitches knitwise, one at a time, to the right needle.
atlas.druty.ujecie.ssk.krok2: Insert the left needle into the fronts of both slipped stitches and knit them together.
atlas.druty.ujecie.ssk.krok3: One stitch remains, leaning to the left.
atlas.druty.ujecie.skp.nazwa: Slip 1, knit 1, pass slipped stitch over (SKP)
atlas.druty.ujecie.skp.podpis: A single decrease that leans to the left.
atlas.druty.ujecie.skp.opis_alt: Drawing of slip 1, knit 1, pass slipped stitch over: the slipped stitch is lifted over the knit stitch, and the result leans to the left.
atlas.druty.ujecie.skp.krok3: Pass the slipped stitch over the knit stitch.
atlas.druty.ujecie.p2tog.podpis: A single decrease; seen from the right side, it leans to the right.
atlas.druty.ujecie.p2tog.opis_alt: Drawing of purl 2 together worked on the wrong side; on the right side the decrease leans to the right.
atlas.druty.ujecie.p2tog.krok1: Purl the next two stitches together as one.
atlas.druty.ujecie.p2tog.krok2: On the right side, the stitch leans to the right.
atlas.druty.ujecie.s2kp2.podpis: A double decrease that leaves one straight, vertical stitch.
atlas.druty.ujecie.s2kp2.opis_alt: Drawing of a centered double decrease: two stitches are slipped together, one is knit, and both slipped stitches pass over it, leaving a vertical stitch.
atlas.druty.ujecie.s2kp2.krok1: Slip the next two stitches together, as if to knit them together.
atlas.druty.ujecie.s2kp2.krok3: Pass both slipped stitches over the knit stitch.
atlas.druty.ujecie.s2kp2.krok4: One vertical stitch remains, leaning neither left nor right.
atlas.druty.dodanie.yo.podpis: Take the yarn over the needle; it leaves a hole in the fabric.
atlas.druty.dodanie.yo.opis_alt: Drawing of a yarn over: the yarn is wrapped over the right needle between two stitches, making a new loop and a hole.
atlas.druty.dodanie.yo.krok1: Take the yarn over the right needle.
atlas.druty.dodanie.yo.krok2: The yarn over leaves a hole in the fabric.
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.nazwa: Make one right (M1R) and make one left (M1L)
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.podpis:
Increases made from the horizontal strand between stitches: make one right leans to the right, make one left leans to the left.
They are almost invisible and leave no hole.
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.opis_alt: Drawing of make one increases: the left needle lifts the strand between two stitches, and the strand is knit with a twist.
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.krok1: Make one right: with the left needle, lift the strand between the stitches from back to front.
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.krok2: Knit the lifted strand through the front loop.
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.krok3: Make one left: with the left needle, lift the strand from front to back.
atlas.druty.dodanie.m1.krok4: Knit the lifted strand through the back loop.
atlas.druty.warkocz.2-2.podpis: With the cable needle held in back, the cable crosses to the right; held in front, it crosses to the left.
atlas.druty.warkocz.2-2.uwaga_zapis: The same cable can also be written as 4-st RC or 4-st LC; some patterns call cables a back cross or a front cross.
atlas.druty.warkocz.2-2.opis_alt: Drawing of a cable over four stitches: two stitches wait on the cable needle while the next two are knit, then the stitches from the cable needle are knit.
atlas.druty.warkocz.2-2.krok1: Slip 2 stitches onto the cable needle and hold it in back for a right cross, or in front for a left cross.
atlas.druty.warkocz.2-2.krok3: Knit the 2 stitches from the cable needle.
atlas.druty.zamykanie.bo.podpis:
Binding off finishes the edge; it is sometimes called casting off.
Unless the pattern says otherwise, bind off in the stitch pattern of the piece.
atlas.druty.zamykanie.bo.opis_alt: Drawing of a knit bind-off: the first stitch on the right needle is lifted over the second and off the needle.
atlas.druty.zamykanie.bo.krok2: With the left needle, lift the first stitch over the second and off the right needle.
atlas.druty.zamykanie.bo.krok3: Knit the next stitch and repeat.
atlas.druty.zamykanie.bo.krok4: When all stitches are bound off, 1 stitch is left on the right needle; pull the yarn through it.
atlas.schemat.brak-oczka.podpis: Some areas of a chart have no stitches.
atlas.schemat.brak-oczka.opis_alt: Drawing of a chart in which a few squares are marked as having no stitch.
atlas.schemat.brak-oczka.krok1: The marked squares hold no stitch.
atlas.schemat.powtorzenia.podpis: An asterisk (*) marks instructions to repeat as directed; brackets [ ] hold instructions you work as many times as the pattern says.
atlas.schemat.powtorzenia.razy: A number after brackets is the total: work the bracketed group that many times in all.
atlas.schemat.powtorzenia.razy_wiecej: “n more times” after the first time means n + 1 times in all.
atlas.schemat.powtorzenia.do_konca: "Rep from * across, end K2" means repeat from the asterisk across the row up to the last stitches, then work the ending.
atlas.schemat.powtorzenia.nawias_okragly: Parentheses ( ) can mean a repeat, or a group of stitches worked into the same stitch or space.
atlas.schemat.rs-ws.nazwa: Reading a chart: right side (RS) and wrong side (WS)
atlas.schemat.rs-ws.podpis: One square is one stitch, and a symbol usually shows the stitch as it looks on the right side.
atlas.schemat.rs-ws.kierunek:
Read the chart from the bottom up.
Worked flat, read right-side rows from right to left and wrong-side rows from left to right, unless the pattern says otherwise.
Worked in the round, read every round from right to left.
atlas.schemat.rs-ws.znaczenie_ws: The same symbol can mean a different stitch on the wrong side: the knit symbol means purl, and the k2tog symbol means p2tog.
atlas.schemat.rs-ws.legenda: Always read the pattern key: symbols and abbreviations vary from pattern to pattern.
atlas.schemat.rs-ws.opis_alt: Drawing of a small chart with arrows: right-side rows run right to left, wrong-side rows left to right, from the bottom up.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ch.podpi:
Catch the yarn and pull it through the loop on the hook.
The loop on the hook is not counted as a stitch.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ch.uwaga: In crochet, the slip knot never counts as a stitch; in knitting, it always does.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ch.opis_: Drawing of a chain: the hook catches the yarn and pulls it through the loop on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ch.krok1: Catch the yarn with the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ch.krok2: Pull it through the loop on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.slst.pod: Insert the hook, catch the yarn, and pull it through both loops on the hook at once.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.slst.opi: Drawing of a slip stitch: the yarn is pulled through the stitch and the loop on the hook in one move.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.slst.kro: Insert the hook and catch the yarn.
Pull the yarn through both loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.sc.podpi: No yarn over before you insert the hook; pull up a loop, then yarn over and pull through both loops.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.sc.uwaga: Work through both loops of the next stitch unless the pattern says otherwise.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.sc.opis_: Drawing of a single crochet: the hook goes into the stitch, a loop is pulled up, and the yarn is pulled through both loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.sc.krok1: Insert the hook from front to back and pull up a loop: 2 loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.sc.krok2: Yarn over and pull through both loops.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.hdc.podp: Yarn over, insert the hook, and pull up a loop: 3 loops on the hook; yarn over and pull through all three.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.hdc.opis: Drawing of a half double crochet: with one yarn over on the hook, a loop is pulled up and then the yarn goes through all loops at once.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.hdc.krok: Yarn over and insert the hook.
Pull up a loop: 3 loops on the hook.
Yarn over and pull through all 3 loops.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.dc.podpi: Yarn over, insert the hook, and pull up a loop: 3 loops on the hook; then twice yarn over and pull through 2 loops.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.dc.opis_: Drawing of a double crochet: with one yarn over, a loop is pulled up, and the loops are worked off two at a time.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.dc.krok1: Yarn over, insert the hook, and pull up a loop: 3 loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.dc.krok2: Yarn over and pull through the first 2 loops: 2 loops remain.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.dc.krok3: Yarn over and pull through the last 2 loops.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.tr.podpi: Yarn over twice, insert the hook, and pull up a loop: 4 loops on the hook; then three times yarn over and pull through 2 loops.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.tr.opis_: Drawing of a treble crochet: with two yarn overs, a loop is pulled up, and the loops are worked off two at a time.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.tr.krok1: Yarn over twice, insert the hook, and pull up a loop: 4 loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.tr.krok2: Yarn over and pull through 2 loops, three times in all.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ring.pod:
A way to start working in the round that leaves no hole in the center.
Starting from a ring of chains leaves a hole that depends on the length of the chain.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ring.opi: Drawing of an adjustable ring: stitches are worked over a loop of yarn and the tail, then the tail is pulled to close the ring.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.ring.kro: Make a loop in the yarn, at least 15 cm from the tail end, and insert the hook through the loop from front to back.
Pull the yarn through and finish the stitch around the loop and the tail held together.
Work the rest of the stitches over both strands, pull the tail to close the ring, and join with a slip stitch.
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.nazwa: Decrease: single crochet 2 together (sc2tog), double crochet 2 together (dc2tog)
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.podpis: Work two stitches without their last step, then yarn over and pull through all loops on the hook; one stitch is decreased.
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.opis_alt: Drawing of a crochet decrease: two unfinished stitches share one top.
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.krok1: Work a double crochet up to its last step: 2 loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.krok2: Do the same in the next stitch: 3 loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.krok3: Yarn over and pull through all 3 loops.
atlas.szydelko.dodanie.inc.podpis: Work one stitch, then work another stitch into the same stitch; one stitch is increased.
atlas.szydelko.dodanie.inc.opis_alt: Drawing of a crochet increase: two stitches grow from the same stitch below.
atlas.szydelko.dodanie.inc.krok2: Insert the hook into the same stitch and work another stitch.
atlas.tabela.us-uk.szydelko.wstep: The same crochet name can mean a different stitch in US and UK patterns.
atlas.tabela.us-uk.szydelko.wiersze:
US slip stitch (sl st) = UK slip stitch (ss).
US single crochet (sc) = UK double crochet (dc).
US half double crochet (hdc) = UK half treble (htr).
US double crochet (dc) = UK treble (tr).
US treble (tr) = UK double treble (dtr).
US double treble (dtr) = UK triple treble (trtr).
US yarn over (yo) = UK yarn over hook (yoh).
US skip = UK miss.
atlas.tabela.us-ca.druty.wiersze:
US bind off = Canada cast off.
US gauge = Canada tension.
US slip stitch (sl st) = Canada slip stitch (ss).
atlas.tabela.skroty.druty.wstep:
These abbreviations follow US knitting terms.
Patterns may also use their own abbreviations, usually explained at the start of the pattern.
atlas.tabela.skroty.druty.wiersze:
k: knit.
p: purl.
St st: stockinette stitch.
rev St st: reverse stockinette stitch.
k2tog: knit 2 together.
ssk: slip, slip, knit.
SKP: slip 1, knit 1, pass slipped stitch over.
p2tog: purl 2 together.
S2KP2: centered double decrease.
yo: yarn over.
M1R: make one right.
M1L: make one left.
BO: bind off.
CO: cast on.
cn: cable needle.
RS: right side.
WS: wrong side.
rep: repeat.
rnd: round.
sl: slip.
kwise: knitwise.
pwise: purlwise.
tbl: through back loop.
wyib: with yarn in back.
wyif: with yarn in front.
psso: pass slipped stitch over.
atlas.tabela.skroty.szydelko.wiersze:
ch: chain.
sl st: slip stitch.
sc: single crochet.
hdc: half double crochet.
dc: double crochet.
tr: treble crochet.
sc2tog: single crochet 2 together.
dc2tog: double crochet 2 together.
inc: increase.
sk: skip.
yo: yarn over.
atlas.tabela.znaki-zapisu.wiersze:
*: repeat the instructions after the asterisk as directed.
* *: repeat the instructions between the asterisks as many times as directed.
[ ]: work the instructions inside the brackets as many times as directed.
( ): work the instructions as many times as directed, or work the group into the same stitch or space.
1 in is exactly 2.54 cm.
atlas.nabieranie.wspolne.wezel: Every cast-on method starts with a slip knot.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.longtail.podpis:
Gives a firm, elastic edge.
Leave a tail about three times the width of the edge you cast on.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.longtail.krok1: Wrap the tail around your left thumb.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.longtail.krok2: Insert the needle upward into the loop on your thumb.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.longtail.krok3: Draw the yarn from the ball through the loop to make a stitch.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.backloop.podpis: The simplest method, with a loose edge of single loops.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.backloop.krok1: Insert the needle upward under the strand on your thumb.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.backloop.krok2: Slip the loop from your thumb onto the needle.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.cable.podpis: Gives a sturdy, elastic edge that suits ribbing.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.cable.krok1: Draw the yarn through the first stitch without dropping it, and place the new stitch on the left needle.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.cable.krok2: For every next stitch, insert the right needle between the last two stitches on the left needle.
atlas.druty.nabieranie.cable.krok3: Pull a loop through and place it on the left needle.
